page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m2.medium is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.m2 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server type does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. It also does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to its high memory density relative to compute resources, the ecs.m2.medium is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive parallel processing power. It is suitable for hosting medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and lightweight data processing pipelines.
